title: Krios Pro Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Klim Krios Pro Hi-Viz Yellow is bridges highway aerodynamic poise with high-flow off-road ventilation, pairing peak visor aerodynamic stability with high-flow dust filtration. Featuring a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber architecture at a featherweight 1347g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~91 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Premium carbon ADV helmet with Transitions photochromic shield.

technical_analysis: Features Hand-laid Karbonite Carbon Fiber shell construction optimized for extreme adventure dual-sport touring paired with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor. The interior utilizes Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Klim Krios Pro Hi-Viz Yellow: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor and Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Klim's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Krios Pro Hi-Viz Yellow brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Klim Krios Pro Hi-Viz Yellow represents Klim's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Klim Krios Pro Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
